    def draw(self, user, positions, width=32):
        excluded_ranks = self.exclusions[user]
        eligible = self.itemnum - excluded_ranks.size
        count = min(width, eligible)
        output = np.zeros((positions, width), dtype=np.int64)
        mask = np.zeros_like(output, dtype=bool)
        if count == 0 or positions == 0:
            return output, mask, eligible
        ranks = self.rng.integers(eligible, size=(positions, count))
        # Keep the first occurrence of each rank. Resample duplicate slots;
        # eight rounds bound rejection work. Catalog-label symmetry makes
        # accepted distinct ordered rows uniform without replacement.
        earlier = np.tril(np.ones((count, count), dtype=bool), k=-1)
        for _ in range(8):
            duplicate = ((ranks[:, :, None] == ranks[:, None, :])
                         & earlier[None]).any(axis=-1)
            if not duplicate.any():
                break
            ranks[duplicate] = self.rng.integers(eligible, size=int(duplicate.sum()))
        duplicate = ((ranks[:, :, None] == ranks[:, None, :])
                     & earlier[None]).any(axis=-1)
        for row in np.flatnonzero(duplicate.any(axis=-1)):
            ranks[row] = self.rng.choice(eligible, size=count, replace=False)
        ids = ranks + 1 + np.searchsorted(excluded_ranks, ranks, side="right")
        output[:, :count] = ids

    def draw(self, user, positions, width=32):
        if positions < 0 or width < 0:
            raise ValueError("Pool dimensions must be nonnegative")
        excluded_ranks = self.exclusions[user]
        eligible = self.itemnum - excluded_ranks.size
        count = min(width, eligible)
        output = np.zeros((positions, width), dtype=np.int64)
        mask = np.zeros_like(output, dtype=bool)
        if count == 0 or positions == 0:
            return output, mask, eligible
        ranks = self.rng.integers(eligible, size=(positions, count))

        def duplicate_slots(values):
            # Stable sorting keeps the earliest occurrence of each rank.
            # This avoids allocating a positions x count x count array.
            order = np.argsort(values, axis=1, kind="stable")
            ordered = np.take_along_axis(values, order, axis=1)
            repeated = np.zeros_like(values, dtype=bool)
            repeated[:, 1:] = ordered[:, 1:] == ordered[:, :-1]
            result = np.zeros_like(repeated)
            np.put_along_axis(result, order, repeated, axis=1)
            return result

        for _ in range(8):
            duplicate = duplicate_slots(ranks)
            if not duplicate.any():
                break
            ranks[duplicate] = self.rng.integers(eligible, size=int(duplicate.sum()))
        duplicate = duplicate_slots(ranks)
        for row in np.flatnonzero(duplicate.any(axis=-1)):
            # Exact ordered uniform fallback, including eligible == count.
            ranks[row] = self.rng.choice(eligible, size=count, replace=False)
        ids = ranks + 1 + np.searchsorted(excluded_ranks, ranks, side="right")
        output[:, :count] = ids
        mask[:, :count] = True
        return output, mask, eligible

def sampled_objective(pos_logits, neg_logits, neg_mask, mode):
    if mode not in ("bce1", "bce32", "softmax32", "softmax32_scaled"):
        raise ValueError(mode)
    if (pos_logits.ndim != 1 or neg_logits.ndim != 2
            or neg_logits.shape[0] != pos_logits.shape[0]
            or neg_mask.shape != neg_logits.shape
            or neg_mask.dtype != torch.bool):
        raise ValueError("Expected N positive logits and matching N x M logits/bool mask")
    if pos_logits.numel() == 0:
        return None
    if not torch.isfinite(pos_logits).all() or not torch.isfinite(neg_logits).all():
        raise FloatingPointError("Nonfinite objective logits")
    if neg_mask.shape[1] > 1 and (neg_mask[:, 1:] & ~neg_mask[:, :-1]).any():
        raise ValueError("Valid negatives must precede masked placeholders")
    counts = neg_mask.sum(-1)
    positive = torch.nn.functional.softplus(-pos_logits)
    if mode == "bce1":
        negative = torch.zeros_like(positive)
        if neg_logits.shape[1]:
            negative = torch.where(
                counts > 0, torch.nn.functional.softplus(neg_logits[:, 0]), negative)
